_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Du bis Speler {player_id} in Tic Tac Toe.
Din doel is om drie in 'n rie (horizontaal, verticaal of diagonaal) op 't bord te winne.
Bij din beurt, mos du 't nummer van 't veldj (0-8) kieze woa du din teike in wilt zitte.
Zoewie '[4]' zet din teike in 't middecel van 't bord.
Es Speler {player_id}, zals du '{symbol}' zeen, dewiel din taegespeler '{opponent_symbol}' is.

invalid_move.wrong_format: De ingediende verhuizing volgt neet 't correcte formaot.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} is not a valid cell. Must be between 0 and 8.

game_action.placed: Speler {player_id} haet zien symbool ({symbol}) in cel {cell} geplaats.
